title: MW2 Rust Zombies
author: Psh

scanner.why: end_game name an ending and are this map's own; script hardcodes cost 500000

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Features: – Does not require T4M! – Harry’s Perks (11 perks) *No Vulture aid and Tombstone* – 100,000 Buyable Ending – No Dogs – No grabbing zombies – All MW2 weapons except the explosives – No Perk Limit -NIGHTMARE MODE (Provides an extreme challenge) -FUN MODE (For those looking for a casual game, includes faster speed and increased points to name a few features) *The end game when in fun mode is 500,000 because it’s fun mode, not grind to the end mode, survive until you die. * *You can combine these modes* *Select the modes by going in coop host settings* 1.01 Changes -Buyable ending now 65,000 (Was 100,000) -Increased knifing speed -Buffed the Vibrator -Zombies no longer spawn miles out of play (To speed up the early rounds) -Fixed other shit Credits: -Tom-Bmx -Harry Bo21 -HitmanVere -ricko0z -JR-Imagine -Treminaor -Rorke -DamianoTBM -Make-Cents -Scobalula -DidUKnowIPwn -RDV -steviewonder87 -JBird632 -Bluntstuffy -DuaLVII -If I missed you plz

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it.
